identifier.value: Seafood Supply Chain and Logistics Platform

product.name: Seafood Supply Chain and Logistics Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting seafood producers, fishermen, and B2B/B2C consumers to facilitate seafood supply chain and logistics from harvest to retail.

product.name: Wholesale Seafood Collection (Gomla Seafood)
product.description: Bulk seafood products offered at discounted prices for restaurants, caterers, retailers, and large families.

product.name: Raw Salmon Products
product.description: Various cuts and preparations of raw salmon including fillets, portions, cubes, sashimi grade, and marinated options.

product.name: Shrimp Products
product.description: A variety of shrimp products including peeled, shell-on, different sizes, and prepared shrimp snacks.

product.name: Seafood Bundles
product.description: Curated seafood product bundles designed for convenient meal preparation and value.

product.name: Sauces, Pastes & Oils
product.description: A selection of sauces, marinades, pastes, and cooking oils to complement seafood preparation.
